explication: Nitro is a complete Arbitrum optimistic-rollup node stack. Its main workflow accepts L2 transactions, executes them through Geth and ArbOS, sequences them into batches, compresses and posts batch data to Ethereum, and supports validation and fraud proofs when execution is disputed. The graph also captures inbox ingestion, data availability, bridges, and Stylus/WASM execution. The README establishes the high-level product capabilities; sampled source confirms execution, ArbOS storage, and selected persistence behavior, so unsampled subsystem wiring is shown only where the documented workflow supports it.
